The accused in Crime No. 574/2018 of Payyanur Police Station, in S.C.No.199/2020 on the file of the Fast Track Special Court, Thaliparamba, filed this Crl.M.C under Section 482 of Crl.M.C praying for quashing all further proceedings against him.

The offences alleged against the petitioner are under Sections 376(2) and 384 of IPC.
2.

The prosecution case is that the accused, after promising to make the defacto complainant a partner in his business, took her to Nagpur for training on 06.05.2016 and committed rape upon her on 08.05.2016, after administering some intoxicating substance to her.
Thereafter, by threatening her, he is alleged to have committed rape upon her again on 12.05.2016, 11.08.2016, and on several other days thereafter.

3. According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, it is a false case against the petitioner and that even if the entire allegations leveled against the petitioner are believed as such, the same will make out only a consensual relationship.
Therefore, he prayed for quashing all further proceedings against the petitioner.
4. The petition was opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor.

5. However, upon instructions, he submits that the defacto complainant had given signed statement to the SHO to the effect that the matter has been settled and also that she does not want to proceed with this case.
However, no affidavit is seen filed before this Court to that effect.
6. On a perusal of the First Information Statement, it appears that the first relationship between the petitioner and the defacto complainant was not a consensual one.

However, it is revealed that,
thereafter, their relationship continued for a considerable period at different places on different dates.
Thereafter, it is prima facie revealed that the relationship between them was a consensual one.
Moreover, at the time of the above relationship, she was married to another person.

In the above circumstances, the allegations leveled against the petitioner does not make out the offences as alleged and as such there is no meaning in continuing the proceedings alleged against the petitioner.
7. In the result, this Crl. M.C is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No.
574/2018 of Payyanur Police Station, in S.C.No.199/2020 on the file of the Fast Track Special Court,
Thaliparamba,, stands quashed.
